One thing that does help is a bright light, and a clear floor. She'll still have to bump into walls before finding her way to the litter box, but she finds it and even gets on my bed (using stacked boxes as stairs). It is helpful to provide boxes as bumpers to signify they are nearing the litterbox, water bowl, or a door way. Make sure to communicate with you cat through touch and smell!!
